observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Global public locations and landmarks (city squares, parks, beaches, tourist sites)
observation.dancers: Mixed groups of adults and children; solo, pairs and groups dancing together
observation.formation_and_space: Informal circles, clusters, or lines moving together in public spaces
observation.posture: Upright torso, relaxed knees with bouncy weight shifts
observation.footwork: Bouncing steps on the beat, side-to-side steps, hops and occasional turning in place
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms raised overhead or waving side to side; holding patterned ajrak shawls or wrapping them around shoulders
observation.partnering: Independent movement in a group, occasional shoulder holds or draping shawls over partners
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Upright level, small hops on the spot, occasional spins
observation.costume_and_props: Casual modern clothing combined with patterned red-and-white ajrak shawls or scarves; some wear traditional Sindhi caps
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot placement and weight transfer details due to varied camera angles, wide shots, and quick cuts between global locations.

signature_moments.what: Group dancing in a line with arms raised overhead, waving hands and ajrak shawls to the beat
Dancers swinging red ajrak shawls in circles overhead while stepping side to side
Dancers bouncing up and down with knees bent, holding arms up and waving shawls near historical monuments
Group skipping sideways in a loose circle holding shawls and waving hands
